g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
24 TIG TACKS through cloth and both rings

svg.text: cloth shown at 15 mm pitch for clarity (actual 2.12 mm pitch)
316L flat 25 x 3 x 1486, roll easy way to Ø476 OD, butt weld W1
316L flat 10 x 3 x 1486, roll to Ø476 OD, butt weld W1
P1-305 12 mesh cut Ø500, trim flush after tacking
1. Make both rings first (round ±0.5, butt seams ground flush), then stretch the cloth on a tensioning frame, sandwich it between the rings in a jig.
2. Tack 24 places through cloth and both rings, trim the cloth to the ring OD, grind the tacks and the OD smooth, passivate.
3. Check on a light table: no torn or distorted openings; mark the deck S1 / S2 with an etch pen (never stamp the product side).
4. Inspect every batch (ITP T18); a torn deck is swapped for the spare and the batch is held for QA.
